entries.zh: 她的白色长发细软无力，一缕缕垂在干瘦的头上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her scalp gleamed like polished bone through her white, sparse hair.
entries.zh: 透过稀疏的白发，她的头皮像磨亮的骨头一样发亮。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had jet black hair, cut short and spiked like a hedgehog.
entries.zh: 他的头发乌黑，剪得很短，像刺猬一样竖起。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She had shiny black hair that fell in a sheet down her back and fanned across her shoulders.
entries.zh: 她亮黑的头发整片垂在背上，又在肩头扇形铺开。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her short hair was still thick and dark, but streaked with lines of pure white.
entries.zh: 她的短发依然浓密乌黑，却夹杂着一道道纯白发丝。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She had a head of tamed, reddish curls that cascaded down her back.
entries.zh: 她梳理整齐的红棕卷发如瀑布般垂在背后。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was losing his hair and combed the remaining strands from one side to the other, then greased them heavily in place.
entries.zh: 他正在脱发，把剩下的头发从一侧梳到另一侧，再抹上厚厚的发油固定。

entries.zh: 银色发箍把她沙色的头发从脸旁拢到后面。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her dark hair was pulled back tight to her head and fastened at the back with an enormous wooden spike.
entries.zh: 她深色的头发被紧紧往后梳，用一根大木簪固定在脑后。

entries.zh: 她满头红棕色卷发如瀑布般披在背后。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her hair was gathered on top of her head and held in place by diamond pins that had turned her hair into a sparkling tiara.
entries.zh: 她把头发盘在头顶，用钻石发夹固定，仿佛戴了一顶闪闪发光的冠冕。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her shiny brown hair swung rhythmically from side to side as she walked.
entries.zh: 她走路时，亮泽的棕发有节奏地左右摆动。

entries.zh: 风的手指梳过她的头发，又把它打成了结。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Stubbly, unshaven; Thin, little, narrow, pencil, goatee; Enormous, heavy, bushy, drooping; Dark, black; Scruffy, grimy, tangled, grizzled, unkempt; Neat, trim
entries.zh: 胡茬丛生、未剃须；细、少、窄、铅笔般细、山羊胡；巨大、浓重、浓密、下垂；深色、黑；邋遢、污脏、纠结、斑白、未修整；整齐、修剪利落。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Grew, sprouted, poked; Curved, drooped; Spread, crept, covered; Cut, trimmed
entries.zh: 生长、冒出、探出；弯曲、下垂；蔓延、逐渐延伸、覆盖；剪、修整。

entries.label: Sentences

entries.zh: 他的黑胡子修得很随便，像是用修篱机剪过的。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His goatee beard and thick glasses made him look slightly eccentric.
entries.zh: 山羊胡和厚眼镜让他显得有点古怪。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Grizzled hair sprouted in all directions from his unkempt, bushy sideburns.
entries.zh: 他蓬乱浓密的鬓角长出灰白毛发，朝各个方向支着。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Dark stubble was spreading across his cheeks and chin, and creeping down his neck.
entries.zh: 深色胡茬遍布他的脸颊和下巴，还一路延伸到脖子。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His beard covered so much of his face that only his nose and black eyes were visible.
entries.zh: 他的胡子遮住了大半张脸，只露出鼻子和黑眼睛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His beard was tangled and grimy with food, which had dribbled when he was eating.
entries.zh: 他的胡子纠结在一起，沾着吃饭时滴落的食物污渍。
